gloss: has been done (and left that way)

definitions.gloss: has been done and left in that state
definitions.explanation: Te-form of a transitive verb plus ある. Describes a state that continues because someone deliberately produced it. The doer is not named, but their intention is felt: {窓|まど}が{開|あ}けてある means someone opened the window on purpose and left it open.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}け→開ける：00563_akeru⟧てある。
examples.english: The window has been left open.
A map is put up on the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}して→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The materials for the meeting have already been printed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やし→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧てある⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are drinks chilled in the fridge, so please help yourself.

notes:
Only transitive verbs take 〜てある, and the object usually shifts from ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to が: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ becomes ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}け→開ける：00563_akeru⟧てある.

FORMS:
- ⟦{書|か}い→書く：00477_kaku⟧てある: is written (and left that way)
- ⟦{書|か}いてあります→書く：00477_kaku⟧: polite
- ⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧: had been written
- ⟦{書|か}い→書く：00477_kaku⟧てない: is not written (contracted, common in speech)

SIMILAR FORMS:
- 〜て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: with an intransitive verb, describes the same state without implying anyone did it (⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}いている→開く：00689_aku⟧, the window is open)
- 〜ておく: to do something in advance; 〜てある describes the state that 〜ておく leaves behind
